acquisition method: The TopN-MS/MS method was used and N was set to 12.
alkylation reagent: alkylated [15 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), 30 min at room temperature]
alkylation concentration: alkylated [15 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), 30 min at room temperature]
cleavage agent: a mixture of trypsin-Lys-C (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) for 4 h
collision energy: a normalized collision energy of 28 was utilized for the activation of ions.
enrichment method: purified using NeutrAvidin Agarose beads according to manufacturer’s recommendations
instrument: Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap MS
coupled to a Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: The positive ion mode nanoelectrospray was utilized.
labeling: two elafin fragments (H-AQEPVK*GPVSTK*PGSCPII-OH and H-PGIK*K*CCEGSCGMACFVPQ-OH), each containing two 13C615N2-labeled lysines, were synthesized
reduction reagent: successively reduced [5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 30 min at 37 °C]
reduction concentration: successively reduced [5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 30 min at 37 °C]
